name: trackiq-amazon-branded-search
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Branded vs. Non-Branded Search
summary: Splits every Amazon Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands search term into branded, competitor, product-targeting and generic buckets, then shows where the ad money really goes — how much is spent on shoppers who already typed the brand, what generic search returns once brand is taken out, whether competitor conquesting pays — and checks organic share on the brand's own name before calling brand spend defence or waste.
